title: Strength
detail: No running today. Strength 25–35 min. Add an easy 20–30 min walk if you feel like it.

title: Easy run
detail: Easy run 4 km. Your first run. Keep it genuinely easy, 7:45–8:30 /km. Use run/walk whenever you need to.

title: Bike or spinning
detail: Bike or spinning 35–45 min, easy and low-impact.

title: Easy run
detail: Easy run 4 km. Easy pace, run/walk allowed.

title: Rest
detail: Rest, or an easy walk if you want to move.

title: Long run
detail: Long run 15–16 km, very easy. The most important week. Do not run fast. The goal is simply to finish the distance without making the knee worse.

title: Rest
detail: Rest, or an easy 25–35 min bike.

title: Shakeout
detail: Very easy 15–20 min jog, or full rest.

title: Half marathon
detail: Race day. Start slower than you think. Use run/walk (9 min run / 1 min walk) from the start if needed. First 5 km very easy, 5–15 km controlled, and only push after 15 km if the knee and energy feel good.
